text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Happy New Year!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, looking forward to working with you this year too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
From here on is the Classic Period.
Let's both stay sharp and focused.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I was so restless even while visiting home,
I ended up running every spare moment I had!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Not only the New Year's training menu my Trainer gave me, but I should also do more strength training and develop some special moves...!
choice_data_list: D-Did you manage to get some rest...?
D-Did you manage to get some rest...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, no need to worry. I'm not overdoing it!
I know very well that rest is important, too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The whole family ate osechi together, flew kites,
played sugoroku, and just had a relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And truth is, while I was visiting home...
I got my hands on something amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-daaa! Here it is—!!!
'New Year's Money' (Otoshidama)!!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can buy the new Carrotman toy
that'll multiply my power many times over!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's head to the toy store right away, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd be happy to join you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we came to the shopping mall and browsed the toy store, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Shoot!
Justice Biko is in an unexpected pinch!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want every single one of these toys, I can't choose~!
What am I supposed to do~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with an array of enticing merch that stirred
her urge to buy, she just couldn't make up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Should I go with a classic transformation item after all...? But everyday merch is really nice too...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "It's precisely at times like this that I should go for something rare... No, wait, mmm-mmm-mmm...!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It's no use anymore~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'll leave the rest to you!
Decide as you like!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whatever happens, I won't have any regrets!
I believe in... your decision!
choice_data_list: Got it, leave it to me...!
Got it, leave it to me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been entrusted with an important decision. Better choose carefully!
The toy she should buy is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You can't beat the classic transformation item!
Alright, I'll go with this!

text_block_list.name: Toy Sounds
text_block_list.text:
—Carotene Boost! Full points!
Vroom vroom vroom, screeeech!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I operated it... a sound played.
Biko Pegasus looked up at me
with sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh!
That looked so cool! That light just nowww!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "When he uses that, Carrotman transforms into Rapid Form and can unleash super speed for three whole minutes!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! Put it on me already!
I wanna play at super speed too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaah!!
Pegasus Full-Power Swingggg!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wearing a sparkling, flashing toy on her chest,
she played her heart out to her content!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! With this, Carrotman can
wake me up every single morning!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I can't wait until tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Time to set the alarm and take a nap!
Trainer, I'm borrowing the sofa!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Wonder what Carrotman
will say to wake me up~♪
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I should take a nap too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that sounds great!
You always seem to stay up late, so
you gotta take a nap once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's just spend today sleeping through New Year's.
Good night, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she was softly snoring asleep.
Soon, my own eyelids grew heavy as well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Carrotman's energetic voice
woke me up feeling fully refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A carrot drone! You've got great taste!
All right, let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I assembled it while having Biko Pegasus read through the instruction manual on the official website.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! It's carrot-shaped!
Now I can even scout the enemy hideout...!
choice_data_list: Let's try flying it right away.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I can pilot it?
That remote control looks kinda tricky...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, show me an example.
I feel like I'd understand way better seeing you actually do it than reading the manual!
choice_data_list: I see, then I'll try it out!
I see, then I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time flying one too, but...
I can't let her down...!
I grip the remote controller with utter seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*purrrrrrr...*)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!! She flew---!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer!
You really can do anything, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You really are reliable! All right, next I'll give it a shot too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her joyful smile and her direct, slightly exaggerated compliments...
The new year began on a truly heartwarming note.
